page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m8.3xlarge is a memory-dense virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 6 physical Intel Xeon processor cores operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware instruction support includes AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, and FMA, backed by 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 33 MB shared L3 cache. Memory allocation stands at 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding an elevated 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, necessitating cloud storage volumes for all disk persistence, while baseline network throughput is rated at 4 Gbps.

Benchmark testing highlights a distinct contrast between single-core throughput and parallel computational efficiency. Single-threaded evaluations, including Geekbench single-core (1085.0), stress-ng single-core (1314.48), and gzip compression (22.51 GB/sec), perform in the bottom 25% of evaluated cloud systems due to the modest 2.5 GHz clock ceiling. Conversely, multi-threaded workloads scale into the middle performance tier, as shown by Geekbench multi-core (5612.0), PassMark CPU (11916.93), and stress-ng multi-core (10501.12). Memory throughput remains steady, reaching 72.4 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 45.95 GB/sec for uncached writes, enabling Redis to record 10.27 million SET operations per second and static web serving to process 9.22 GB/sec.

Qualitatively, the ecs.u1-c1m8.3xlarge offers strong resource density for enterprise memory requirements without the high compute cost overhead of specialized high-frequency nodes. Tradeoffs center on the low single-core compute performance and absence of built-in storage. Machine learning inference degrades notably above small architectures, with medium 7B models executing in the weak-to-poor performance range (15.86 prompt tokens/sec and 8.66 text generation tokens/sec). The instance is best suited for memory-bound systems such as in-memory databases, Redis caches, large Java application servers, intermediate ETL data manipulation, and mid-tier backend services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m8.3xlarge is a memory-oriented virtual machine powered by 12 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs across 6 physical cores clocked at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 96.0 GB of RAM, resulting in an 8.0 GB per vCPU distribution, while featuring 4 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth without local disk storage or GPU acceleration. In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates modest single-core throughput, reflected in weak single-thread Geekbench and compression metrics, but maintains solid middle-tier results in multi-core processing, memory bandwidth, and caching operations. Delivering 10.27 million Redis SET operations per second and stable memory read speeds of 72.4 GB/sec, it presents an efficient profile for memory-intensive enterprise tasks. The instance is recommended for workloads such as in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, enterprise application servers, and lightweight ETL pipelines where high memory capacity takes precedence over raw single-threaded CPU speed.
